in_sanskrit.name: Moynal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Moynal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Moynal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘moon’. It is believed to be a tribute to the goddess of the moon, who is known for her nurturing and calming influence. In Hindu mythology, the moon goddess is often associated with motherhood and is revered for her ability to soothe and protect.
